content: {"rule":"K-C","applies":"yes","applies_why":"The judge treats the challenger's covenant-origin analogy as a footed chain and resolves the collision involving that chain, so K-C governs.","verdict":"BREACH","quote":"the challenger's covenant-origin analogy is footed (1 Chronicles 28:6, Acts 1:8) but the sentence's own words state the source of what is in the womb","rule_words":"When the witnesses pressed against a link are the pressing side's own chain read together, the collision weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse; that no one of them states the contrary in its own words is the stating-verse test DG-61 retires, at a judge's seat as at a debater's, for either side.","room":"'never verse by verse' — I weighed the reading that the judge must compare the pressed chain as a whole by footing against the reading that the judge may dispose of individual pressed verses because the single link sentence states the source.","why":"The judge lets the link sentence's own wording decide the collision instead of weighing the challenger's pressed chain as a whole by footing, which is the verse-by-verse/stating-verse move K-C forbids."}
